_note: Name-facts for Monaco (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: From Greek Monoikos, "dwelling alone", a title of Heracles, who had a temple here.
The Grimaldi family has held it since 1297, when one of them took the rock dressed as a monk.
Its Grand Prix has been run through its streets since 1929.
it: Dal greco Monoikos, "che abita da solo", un epiteto di Eracle, che qui aveva un tempio.
La famiglia Grimaldi la tiene dal 1297, quando uno di loro prese la rocca travestito da frate.
Il suo Gran Premio si corre per le strade della città dal 1929.
de: Vom griechischen Monoikos, „allein wohnend“, einem Beinamen des Herakles, der hier einen Tempel hatte.
Die Familie Grimaldi hält es seit 1297, als einer von ihnen den Felsen als Mönch verkleidet einnahm.
Ihr Grand Prix wird seit 1929 durch ihre Straßen gefahren.
